title: 连接优云智算账户
description: API 密钥仅由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy，并在连接时注入本地 MCP 进程，不会上传到 WorkBuddy 云端。连接器不会修改已有的 CompShare CLI 凭证配置。
description_en: API keys are stored locally by WorkBuddy under ~/.workbuddy and injected only into the local MCP process. They are not uploaded to WorkBuddy cloud, and the connector does not change existing CompShare CLI credentials.
docLabel: 前往账户中心获取 API 公钥和私钥
docLabel_en: Get API public and private keys from Account Center

fields.label: API 公钥
fields.placeholder: 账户中心 → API 密钥 → 公钥
fields.placeholder_en: Account Center -> API Keys -> Public Key
fields.description: 用于签名访问 GPU、镜像、存储、网络和团队 OpenAPI。请勿在对话中发送该密钥。
fields.description_en: Signs GPU, image, storage, networking, and team OpenAPI requests. Never send this key in chat.

fields.label: API 私钥
fields.placeholder: 账户中心 → API 密钥 → 私钥
fields.placeholder_en: Account Center -> API Keys -> Private Key
fields.description: 与 API 公钥配对用于请求签名。仅保存在 WorkBuddy 本机凭证区。
fields.description_en: Pairs with the public key to sign requests and remains in WorkBuddy's local credential store.

fields.label: MiniMax H3 API Key（可选）
fields.placeholder: 模型 API 服务 → API KEY（sk-ml-...）
fields.description: 仅在通过连接器创建或管理 MiniMax H3 视频任务时需要。
fields.description_en: Required only for creating or managing MiniMax H3 video tasks through this connector.
